dict.string: ScamShield checks whether a caller is in your contacts so people you know are never filed as spam. Contacts never leave this Mac.
ScamShield matches voicemails against upcoming appointments (e.g. a dentist confirming a visit) so they reach Needs Attention. Calendar data never leaves this Mac.
ScamShield puts calls that need you into a "ScamShield" Reminders list so they reach your iPhone through iCloud, and reads back the ones you tick off or move.
ScamShield delivers calls that need you to your iPhone through Reminders.
ScamShield matches voicemails against upcoming appointments. Calendar data never leaves this Mac.
